title: Pack a colour into bit fields
description:
Write the struct and two functions:

```c
struct rgb565 { unsigned blue : 5; unsigned green : 6; unsigned red : 5; };

struct rgb565 to_rgb565(int r, int g, int b);   /* 0-255 each: keep the top 5, 6 and 5 bits */
void from_rgb565(struct rgb565 c, int *r, int *g, int *b);
                                                 /* back to 0-255: shift up and copy the top bits down,
                                                    so 31 becomes 255 and 0 stays 0 */
```

`to_rgb565(255, 128, 0)` gives red 31, green 32, blue 0. `from_rgb565` turns red 31 into `(31 << 3) | (31 >> 2)` = 255, green 32 into `(32 << 2) | (32 >> 4)` = 130.
hints: Keeping the top 5 bits of a 0–255 value is a shift right by 3; the top 6 bits, by 2. A bit field keeps only as many bits as its width.
lessonTitle: Struct Layout, Alignment and Bit Fields
